body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom vanity with a vanity top accessorie toilet tissue holder crafted from solid brass, designed for easy countertop placement when wall space is limited in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures.

  • Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom

  • Weight: 4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder

Works well with modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures.
